01-hud-with-multi-model-consensus.png.caption: The main window. The activity log on the left tracks tool routing and model agreement in real time; the panel on the right shows which tier of consensus the current answer reached before it was returned.

02-capability-map-by-department.png.caption: Every capability, grouped by department. Blue nodes run unattended, amber nodes require approval before they execute, and dashed nodes are planned but not yet live.

03-tool-routing-and-escalation-log.png.caption: A single turn in detail: the local model narrows 68 tools down to the 5 relevant to a calendar question, then two models are scored for agreement before any answer is returned.

04-idea-capture-and-project-proposals.pn.caption: A captured idea after the background pass: classified, turned into a project plan, and annotated with which steps reuse an existing tool, need a new one, or are still unclear. Nothing executes until the proposal is approved.

05-autonomous-morning-brief.png.caption: The end of the chain: a morning brief assembled from calendar and inbox state and sent without being asked.
